segments.an10.195:1.1: “Bhāvetabbañca vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desessāmi na bhāvetabbañca.
segments.an10.195:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, na bhāvetabbo dhammo?
segments.an10.195:1.4: Pāṇātipāto … pe … micchādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, na bhāvetabbo dhammo.
segments.an10.195:2.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī … pe … sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhāvetabbo dhammo”ti.

lines: Sevālamālikāti pātova udakaṃ orohitvā sevālañceva uppalādīni ca gahetvā attano udakasuddhikabhāvajānanatthañceva “lokassa ca udakena suddhi hotī”ti imassa atthassa jānanatthañca mālaṃ katvā pilandhanakā.
